fullTextEN: I am Sika from Taiwan,
How are you all?

fullTextZH: 欢迎回到周杰伦的故事系列。
fullTextEN: Welcome back to the Jay Chou story series.
In the story of the first episode,

fullTextZH: 我们讲到周杰伦长大的故事，
fullTextEN: We talked about Jay Chou's growing up story,

fullTextZH: 故事里我们说到他有一首歌叫《听妈妈的话》今天我想跟大家介绍这首歌。
fullTextEN: In the story, we mentioned he has a song called 'Listen to Mother's Words' and today I want to introduce this song to everyone.
This song is from 2006,

fullTextZH: 到现在还是很多人喜欢。
fullTextEN: Even now, many people still like it.
What is special about it?

fullTextZH: 这首歌的歌词和歌曲都是周杰伦自己写的，
fullTextEN: Both the lyrics and the song of this song were written by Jay Chou himself,
Not only is the song pleasant,
The lyrics are also very touching,
It just warms people's hearts,
It makes you feel like crying a bit.
The lyrics are not about love,

fullTextZH: 而是在说他自己长大的故事。
fullTextEN: But about his own growing up story.
When Jay Chou was 14 years old,
His parents divorced,
It was his mother who took care of him growing up,

fullTextZH: 所以妈妈对他来说非常重要，
fullTextEN: So his mother is very important to him,
It has a big impact on him.

fullTextZH: 他写了这首歌送给妈妈，
fullTextEN: He wrote this song for his mom,
To thank mom for her hard work,

fullTextZH: 他也希望听这首歌的人能想想妈妈的辛苦和妈妈对我们的爱。
fullTextEN: He also hopes that people who listen to this song will think about mom's hard work and her love for us.

fullTextZH: 有一所台湾的小学要学生们学这首歌，
fullTextEN: An elementary school in Taiwan wants students to learn this song,

fullTextZH: 希望小朋友们能从歌词中学会孝顺妈妈，
fullTextEN: Hoping the children can learn to be filial to their mothers from the lyrics,

fullTextZH: 孝顺就是要听妈妈的话，
fullTextEN: Being filial means listening to mom,
Make mom happy,
If mom needs us,
We should take care of her.

fullTextZH: 现在我们一起来看看这首歌的歌词。
fullTextEN: Now let's take a look at the lyrics of this song.
Children,
Do you have many questions?

fullTextZH: 为什么别人在那看漫画，
fullTextEN: Why are others reading comics there,
while I'm learning to draw?
Talking to the piano?
Others are playing games.

fullTextZH: 我却靠在墙壁背我的 ABC.
fullTextEN: While I'm leaning against the wall reciting my ABCs.

fullTextZH: 我说我要一台大大的飞机，
fullTextEN: I said I want a big airplane,

fullTextZH: 但却得到一台旧旧录音机。
fullTextEN: but got an old tape recorder instead.

fullTextZH: 周杰伦 4 岁就开始练钢琴。
fullTextEN: Jay Chou started practicing piano at the age of 4.

fullTextZH: 他小的时候总是羡慕其他小朋友可以去玩，
fullTextEN: When he was young, he always envied other kids who could go play,
and watch TV.
But his mother was very strict,
forcing him to practice piano,
learn to draw,
he felt it was very unfair.

fullTextZH: 小周杰伦不能理解妈妈，
fullTextEN: Little Jay Chou couldn't understand his mother,

fullTextZH: 这段歌词写的就是他小时候的想法。
fullTextEN: this part of the lyrics is about his childhood thoughts.

fullTextZH: 现在我们来看看下一段歌词，
fullTextEN: Now let's look at the next part of the lyrics,
Why should you listen to your mother?

fullTextZH: 长大后你就会开始懂了这段话：长大后，
fullTextEN: When you grow up, you'll start to understand this phrase: when you grow up,

fullTextZH: 我开始明白为什么我跑得比别人快，
fullTextEN: I began to understand why I ran faster than others,
and flew higher than others.
In the future

fullTextZH: 大家看的都是我画的漫画，
fullTextEN: everyone will see the comics I drew,

fullTextZH: 大家唱的都是我写的歌。
fullTextEN: everyone will sing the songs I wrote.

fullTextZH: 妈妈的辛苦不让你看见，温暖的食谱在他心里面，
fullTextEN: Mom's hard work is not shown to you, the warm recipes are in his heart,
when you have time, hold her hand more,
hold hands and wander together,
Holding mom's hand,
Dreaming together,
Playing together,
It's about spending more time with mom.
So when Jay Chou grew up,

fullTextZH: 他发现妈妈要他练钢琴学画画对他来说是很好的，
fullTextEN: He realized that his mom wanting him to practice piano and learn painting was good for him,

fullTextZH: 大家都羡慕他会做这些事情，
fullTextEN: Everyone envies him for being able to do these things,

fullTextZH: 大家都羡慕他这些事情做的比别人好，
fullTextEN: Everyone envies him for doing these things better than others,

fullTextZH: 所以他开始明白原来妈妈是对的，
fullTextEN: So he began to understand that mom was right,
And mom is very hardworking.

fullTextZH: 接下来是这首歌的副歌，
fullTextEN: Next is the chorus of this song,

fullTextZH: 就是一首歌重复的部分。
fullTextEN: It's the repeated part of a song.
Listen to mom,
Don't let her get hurt,
Want to grow up quickly,
Only then can you protect her

fullTextZH: 美丽的白发，幸福中发芽，
fullTextEN: Beautiful white hair, sprouting in happiness,

fullTextZH: 意思是妈妈的白头发慢慢地长出来了，
fullTextEN: It means mom's white hair is slowly growing,
Mom is slowly getting older.
Angel's magic,
Warmth and kindness.

fullTextZH: 所以妈妈的爱好像天使的魔法，
fullTextEN: So a mother's love is like an angel's magic,

fullTextZH: 让人感觉很温暖很舒服。
fullTextEN: Makes people feel very warm and comfortable.

fullTextZH: 所以这段歌词写的是周杰伦长大以后对妈妈的感谢，
fullTextEN: So these lyrics are about Jay Chou's gratitude to his mother after growing up,

fullTextZH: 还有想要报答妈妈的心。
fullTextEN: And the desire to repay his mother.

fullTextZH: 以前是妈妈教他保护他，
fullTextEN: In the past, it was his mother who taught and protected him,
Now the child has grown up,
The child is strong now,
Now it's the child's turn to protect the mother,
Be filial to the mother.

fullTextZH: 还有一些歌词是周杰伦想对小时候的自己说的话，
fullTextEN: There are also some lyrics that Jay Chou wants to say to his younger self,
For example, in your future,
Music is your trump card,

fullTextZH: 就是告诉小时候的自己，
fullTextEN: Just to tell his younger self,
After growing up,

fullTextZH: 你会变成华语音乐的天王，
fullTextEN: You will become the king of Mandarin music,
Better listen to your mother,
Delay love a bit.
You will start to learn,

fullTextZH: 其他同学在书包写东写西，
fullTextEN: Other classmates write all over their backpacks,
But I suggest it's best to write: Mom,
I will study hard.

fullTextZH: 所以他告诉小时候的自己，
fullTextEN: So he tells his younger self,

fullTextZH: 如果你要在书包上写字，
fullTextEN: If you want to write on the backpack,
Just write Mom,
I will study hard.

fullTextZH: 这首歌里周杰伦还提到两个明星，
fullTextEN: In this song, Jay Chou also mentions two celebrities,
Chow Yun-fat and Jacky Cheung,

fullTextZH: 这两个人都是他小时候的偶像。
fullTextEN: These two people were his childhood idols.

fullTextZH: 周杰伦长大以后和周润发一起拍了电影，
fullTextEN: After Jay Chou grew up, he made a movie with Chow Yun-fat,

fullTextZH: 周杰伦说我小时候看的都是周润发的电影，
fullTextEN: Jay Chou said I watched all of Chow Yun-fat's movies when I was young,

fullTextZH: 没想到我长大以后可以跟他一起合作，
fullTextEN: I never thought I could work with him when I grew up,

fullTextZH: 真想跟小时候的自己炫耀啊，
fullTextEN: I really want to brag to my younger self,

fullTextZH: 炫耀就是告诉大家我跟这个明星一起工作，
fullTextEN: Bragging is telling everyone I worked with this celebrity,
Impressive, right?
Make everyone envy him.

fullTextZH: 所以周杰伦把这种感觉写进这首歌里，
fullTextEN: So Jay Chou wrote this feeling into the song,

fullTextZH: 如果你去看这首歌的音乐影片，
fullTextEN: If you watch the music video of this song,

fullTextZH: 你会看到周杰伦在对一个小朋友唱歌，
fullTextEN: You will see Jay Chou singing to a child,

fullTextZH: 就像在对小时候的自己说话。
fullTextEN: Just like talking to his younger self.

fullTextZH: 那在做这首歌的音乐影片的时候，
fullTextEN: When making the music video for this song,

fullTextZH: 本来周杰伦想让妈妈在音乐影片里面，
fullTextEN: Originally, Jay Chou wanted his mom to be in the music video,
But Jay's mom was too shy,
Sorry,

fullTextZH: 所以周妈妈没有在影片里面，
fullTextEN: So Jay's mom wasn't in the video,

fullTextZH: 不过你还是可以看到周杰伦小时候和妈妈的照片。
fullTextEN: But you can still see photos of Jay Chou with his mom when he was young.

fullTextZH: 周妈妈第一次听到这首歌的时候，
fullTextEN: When Jay's mom first heard this song,
She was very moved,
Her heart felt warm and hot,
She was moved to tears.

fullTextZH: 他觉得儿子理解她的辛苦，
fullTextEN: He felt that his son understood her hardships,

fullTextZH: 现在周杰伦变成这么有名的歌手，
fullTextEN: Now Jay Chou has become such a famous singer,
He hasn't forgotten to thank his mom.

fullTextZH: 周妈妈很开心能有这么孝顺的儿子。
fullTextEN: Jay's mom is very happy to have such a filial son.

fullTextZH: 现在你了解了这首歌的意思，
fullTextEN: Now you understand the meaning of this song,
And the story behind it,
You can go and listen.
The chorus is slower,

fullTextZH: 你也可以试着唱唱看哦。
fullTextEN: You can also try singing it.

fullTextZH: 让我们知道你觉得这首歌怎么样。
fullTextEN: Let us know what you think of this song.
Then we'll see you next episode,
Bye bye.
